name: josemodi97/yii2-ecitizen-gateway
description: Beginner-friendly eCitizen payment gateway: build signed checkout payloads and verify callbacks with plain-English fields. Plain PHP, no required dependencies — works with Yii2, Yii3, or standalone.

suggest.yiisoft/yii2: Only needed for the optional Yii2-specific extras: EcitizenPaymentTrait, EcitizenInvoiceInterface, EcitizenGateway::absoluteUrl(), or registering EcitizenGateway as a Yii2 application component. EcitizenClient, the main entry point, needs nothing beyond PHP itself.
